:::{#def-inequality}
#### Inequality

An **inequality** is a proposition (@def-proposition)
or a predicate (@def-predicate)
that compares two expressions $a$ and $b$
whose values are [real numbers](number-systems.qmd#def-real-numbers),
in one of the forms:

- $a < b$ ("$a$ is less than $b$");
- $a \le b$ ("$a$ is less than or equal to $b$");
- $a > b$ ("$a$ is greater than $b$");
- $a \ge b$ ("$a$ is greater than or equal to $b$").

:::
